title: 第13章 新欢旧爱第14章 清王沈青铉
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
“殿下，奴婢决定了。”小梨拍了拍自己胸口，“以后一定要苦练厨艺，把妖肉做成天下第一美味，让殿下吃开心。”
沈青鱼笑道：“那你可要努力了。”
这玩意是真难吃，若是小梨能有这个本事，自然是最好不过。
周荣连闯好几回长公主府，都没有成功进去，肺都要被气炸。
“沈青鱼，你能不能不要这么作，废物就要有当废物的觉悟？不要以为自己是公主，就可以为所欲为。”
门上抽开一个板子，露出来一条缝，里面的人冲着周荣喊。
“我家殿下乃皇朝百年来出生的唯一公主，先帝亲封的赤阳长公主，任性一点点怎么了？没吃你们家大米，也不欺负别人。也就驸马爷你觉得我家殿下不好，别人都觉得我家殿下挺好的，是不是啊大家。”
这番闹的动静不小，长公主府门外聚集了不少人，都在看热闹，闻言都笑着大声起哄应和。
都知道长公主身娇体弱，吃不了一点点苦，也确实有那么点任性。可细想一下，确实没祸害人啊，甚至人还怪好的。
若有妖魔作乱，求到长公主府，一般都能得到帮助。
听说长公主开始养面首了，不少人就起了心思。
“殿下还要面首不要啊，我身体强壮，资质不比周世子差。”
“我儿子十六，年轻帅气。”
“我孙子听话，有口饭吃就行。”
……
周荣气得脸都绿了，这都什么跟什么。
一群异想天开的贱民，沈青鱼如此爱他，怎么可能会养面首。
至于云珏，周荣不怎担心。
那废物都那个样子了，身体连动一下都不行，应该没那个本事给他戴绿帽子。

可一直站在这里，被一群人指指点点，调侃长公主有了新欢，要把自己这个旧爱抛弃，周荣感觉脸都丢尽了。
正好府上差人来寻，说柳晶晶不舒服，周荣忙顺着这台阶跑了。
沈青鱼，你给本世子等着。
真以为自己是长公主就可以任性，新帝刚登基不好对你这个先帝余孽动手。等陛下帝位稳固了，迟早把你姐弟二人清算。到时候除了本世子，还有谁会收留你，保护你。
阿嚏！
沈青鱼揉了揉发痒的鼻子，总感觉有人在骂自己。
她思索片刻，就这两天发生的事情，估计想骂她的人有不少。
放心上太累，就不放了。
吃饱喝足推着轮椅就朝院子那边澡池走去，夜里挺忙的，总叫水也挺麻烦的，正好澡池有活水，能省不少事情。
“沈青鱼，你别告诉我你又想了。”
“恭喜你猜对了，生命不止，修炼不息，我可是个十分努力的人。”
“不知廉耻。”
“有本事你跑啊。”
“……”
云珏心想，自己要是能跑的话，还能留在这里给她反复折腾？
为了能让周荣和离，柳晶晶可算是下了血本，把自己的清白都交了出去，与周荣温存了一整夜。
次日她腰酸背痛，再次提及和离的事情。以为两人都这样了，周荣怎么也会答应。
没曾想周荣一听，断然否决。

"Your Highness, this servant has decided." Xiaoli patted her chest, "In the future, I must work hard on my cooking skills and make the demon meat the most delicious in the world, so that Your Highness can enjoy it."
Shen Qingyu smiled and said, "Then you have to work hard."
This thing is really unpalatable. If Xiaoli can do this, it would be the best.
Zhou Rong broke into the eldest princess's mansion several times, but failed to get in, and his lungs were about to explode.
"Shen Qingyu, can you please stop doing this? A waste must have the consciousness of being a waste? Don't think that just because you are a princess, you can do whatever you want."
A panel on the door was pulled open, revealing a crack, and the person inside shouted at Zhou Rong.
"My Highness is the only princess born in the dynasty for hundreds of years. Princess Chiyang, who was personally named by the late emperor, is a little willful. She doesn't eat your rice, and she doesn't bully others. I mean, Prince Consort, you think my Highness is not good, but others think my Highness is pretty good, right?"
This commotion was quite commotion, and many people gathered outside the gate of the eldest princess's residence, all watching the commotion. They laughed and cheered loudly when they heard what was said.
Everyone knows that the eldest princess is delicate and frail, can't bear a little hardship, and is indeed a little willful. But if you think about it carefully, it really doesn’t harm anyone. In fact, people are actually kind.
If there are demons causing trouble, you can usually get help by going to the eldest princess's mansion.
When they heard that the eldest princess had started raising noodles, many people became interested.
"Your Highness, you still want to show your face. I am physically strong and my qualifications are no worse than those of Prince Zhou."
"My son is sixteen, young and handsome."
"My grandson is obedient and has enough to eat."
…
Zhou Rong was so angry that his face turned green. This was nothing.
How could Shen Qingyu, a group of whimsical pariahs, love him so much and have a good reputation.
As for Yun Jue, Zhou Rong is not too worried.
That loser is in such a state that he can't even move his body, so he probably doesn't have the ability to cuckold him.
But standing here all the time, being pointed at by a group of people and teasing the eldest princess that she had a new love and that she wanted to abandon her old love, Zhou Rong felt completely humiliated.
Just as the family sent someone to look for her, saying that Liu Jingjing was not feeling well, Zhou Rong hurriedly ran down the steps.
Shen Qingyu, please wait for me.
I really thought that since I was the eldest princess, I could be willful. The new emperor had just ascended the throne and it was hard to take action against you, a remnant of the previous emperor. When His Majesty's throne is secure, sooner or later you and your brother will be liquidated. When the time comes, who else will take you in and protect you except this prince?
Ah sneeze!
Shen Qingyu rubbed his itchy nose, feeling like someone was scolding him.
She thought for a moment and realized that there were probably many people who wanted to scold her based on what happened in the past two days.
Don't worry, I'm too tired, so I won't let go.
After eating and drinking, I pushed my wheelchair toward the bathhouse in the yard. It was very busy at night, and it was troublesome to always ask for water. It happened that the bathhouse had running water, which saved a lot of trouble.
"Shen Qingyu, don't tell me that you think about it again."
"Congratulations on your guess. Life is endless and cultivation is endless. I am a very hard-working person."
"Shameless."
"Run if you can."
"..."
Yun Jue thought to herself, if he could run away, how could he stay here and torment her again and again?
In order to make Zhou Rong reconcile, Liu Jingjing spent a lot of money, handed over her innocence, and spent the whole night with Zhou Rongwen.
The next day she had a sore back and mentioned the divorce again. I thought Zhou Rong would agree if both of them were like this.
I never thought Zhou Rong would categorically reject it.
